Tariq Hassan  
📞 +91 98765 43210 | 📧 tariqhassan@email.com | 📍 Bengaluru, India  

**Education**  
Master’s in Data Science  
University of Tech Innovations | 2020  
Focused on machine learning algorithms, distributed systems, and big data analytics. Thesis: “Optimizing Real-Time Data Pipelines Using Hybrid Cloud Architectures.”  

**Professional Experience / Work History**  
**Data Engineer Lead**  
NexaFlow Solutions (Startup, 50–250 employees) | 2022–present  
Led a team of 4 engineers to build scalable data infrastructure for SaaS platforms.  
- Designed and deployed Snowflake-based data warehouses to consolidate customer analytics, reducing query latency by 40% and improving data accuracy.  
- Integrated Apache Kafka with Apache Spark for real-time fraud detection, enabling sub-second processing of 10M+ transactions daily.  
- Automated CI/CD pipelines using Terraform and Docker, cutting deployment time by 30% and minimizing manual errors.  
- Collaborated with DevOps to migrate legacy systems to AWS, streamlining resource management and reducing costs by 15%.  

**Junior Data Engineer**  
Streamlytics Inc. (Startup, 50–250 employees) | 2020–2022  
Developed ETL workflows for customer engagement data using Apache Airflow, ensuring timely delivery of insights to product teams.  
- Built data lakes on AWS S3 to store unstructured logs, enabling 20% faster troubleshooting for client support teams.  
- Optimized data workflows with Apache Spark, reducing batch processing time from 4 hours to 15 minutes for 10TB datasets.  
- Mentored two interns on cloud-native practices, fostering a culture of self-service analytics within the team.  

**Data Analyst Intern**  
CloudGenix Technologies (Startup, 50–250 employees) | 2019–2020  
Analyzed user behavior metrics to identify trends in product adoption, contributing to a 12% increase in monthly active users.  
- Created dashboards using Tableau to visualize conversion funnels, guiding marketing strategies for high-value segments.  
- Collaborated with engineers to document data pipelines, improving cross-team alignment and reducing onboarding time for new hires.  

**Projects / Side Projects**  
**Real-Time Analytics Platform**  
Built a scalable analytics dashboard for a fintech client using Kafka, Spark, and Snowflake. Enabled real-time monitoring of transaction patterns, helping detect anomalies 10x faster than previous methods.  

**Cloud-Native ETL Framework**  
Developed a modular ETL framework using Airflow and AWS Lambda, allowing teams to deploy data workflows without infrastructure overhead. Reduced deployment complexity by 50% across three projects.  

**Self-Service BI Tooling**  
Designed a Snowflake-based data mart with pre-aggregated tables, empowering business users to generate reports independently. Cut reporting cycle time from days to hours.  

**Technical Skills / Technologies**  
- **AWS**: Managed EC2 clusters and S3 storage for data lakes, integrated with CloudWatch for monitoring.  
- **Apache Kafka**: Engineered high-throughput pipelines for log aggregation, ensuring 99.9% uptime for critical services.  
- **Data Warehousing**: Architected Snowflake schemas to support complex joins and ad-hoc querying for analytics teams.  
- **Docker**: Containerized microservices for consistent environments, reducing dependency conflicts in multi-team projects.  
- **Terraform**: Automated infrastructure provisioning for cloud resources, aligning with team CI/CD practices.  
- **Apache Airflow**: Orchestrated workflows for batch and real-time data pipelines, ensuring reliability across 15+ projects.  
- **Apache Spark**: Processed large datasets for machine learning models, achieving 95% accuracy in predictive analytics.  
- **Snowflake**: Optimized query performance through partitioning and materialized views, supporting 500+ concurrent users.  

**Certifications**  
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (2021)  
- Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (2022)  

**Awards & Achievements**  
- Recognized as “Innovator of the Year” at NexaFlow Solutions (2023) for leading the migration to cloud-native architectures.  
- Featured in TechRise Magazine (2022) for contributions to open-source data pipeline tools.  
- Received a stipend for thesis research on hybrid cloud optimization (University of Tech Innovations, 2020).
